The '''wife''' of [[Aleos Narek]] worked at [[Gender/Legends|her]] father's [[Aleos Narek's shop|shop]], When she [[Marriage/Legends|married]] Aleos, she took control of the store along with him. Around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], she was killed along with Aleos Narek and her two children in the [[Bombing of Rialla Way]].<ref name="Arda" />
